issues.explanation: Chapter 30 states that Zhang He and Gao Lan defected to Cao Cao. Chapter 31 then places Gao Lan among the forces attacking Liu Bei, where Zhao Yun kills him, and has Zhang He present as an opposing Yuan general, without explaining any return to Yuan Shao.
issues.suggested_fix: Either omit their defection in Chapter 30, or clarify in Chapter 31 that they were captured, defected back, or otherwise returned to Yuan Shao before the battle.
